cohort: 100 test queries drawn with random.Random('beir-screen-20261005-scifact').sample(sorted ids, 100); same queries for every added arm.
failure_policy: No retries. A failed query stays in the cohort with an empty ranking. Collection stops after three failed queries in a row.
method: Sentence-transformers CrossEncoder with the model's own default prompt, one query-passage pair per row, ranked by raw score; ties by document ID. Inputs longer than 2,048 tokens are cut and counted.
primary: qwen3-4b minus hybrid, nDCG@10 on the comparison queries, paired bootstrap over queries, 95% interval
limits: Added after the first comparison showed the 2021 and 2023 cross-encoders did not beat hybrid search; chosen from current public leaderboards and deployment surveys before any of them ran.
100 randomly drawn test queries per dataset.
Timing is Apple MPS; these models are usually served on CUDA.
Public benchmark text may be in any model's training data.
